long_description:
Embrace the Festivity of Diwali Dandiya & Halloween Festival 2026
Mark your calendars for the 31st of October, 2026, as we bring to you the unique fusion of Indian and Western cultures with the Diwali Dandiya & Halloween Festival 2026. Immerse yourself in the vibrant energy of Hindi, Gujarati, and English music as we celebrate Diwali and Navratri/Dandiya in a multilingual setting. Don't miss this chance to be a part of an unforgettable experience where the traditional Dandiya meets the spooky vibes of Halloween.
Artistic Endeavors Unveiled
While we are not featuring a specific artist, the event itself is a canvas painted with diverse cultural hues. The Diwali Dandiya & Halloween Festival 2026 is an artist in its own right, showcasing the rich tapestry of Indian and Western traditions. The event aims to resonate with the attendees' cultural roots while also bringing them a taste of international festivity.
Experience the Splendor at Live Oak Park
The festival will be held at the beautiful Live Oak Park, located at 641 Moreland Way, Santa Clara, CA, United States. Known for its safety and accessibility, the venue is a welcoming space for everyone. The park's serene ambience enhances the experience of the festival. Parking will not be a concern as ample space is available. And, to add an extra touch of India to your day, we recommend visiting the nearby Indian restaurants for a delightful culinary journey.
Reserve Your Spot: Early Bird Tickets
Be the early bird that catches the worm! Secure your place at the Diwali Dandiya & Halloween Festival 2026 for just $10.00. Don't miss out on this wonderful opportunity to celebrate two of the most vibrant festivals in a unique fusion event. Hurry! Grab your tickets now and get ready for a day filled with fun, music, and festivity.
